data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 弦神岛海滨的纯白比基尼娇羞
data.description: 弦神岛人工海滩的遮阳伞下，碧波荡漾。雪菜身穿一袭纯白色的日系花边比基尼，双手害羞地护在胸前。湿漉漉的乌黑长发在阳光下散发着柔润光泽，圆润的香肩与纤细锁骨在微风中轻颤。平日一本正经的剑巫少女，此刻从头到脚都泛着可爱的粉红，微低着头用清澈的眼眸羞怯地望着你。
data.action: sitting under beach umbrella in pure white frilled bikini, holding hands shyly over chest, black hair glistening, blushing intensely with downcast then meeting eyes
data.location: tropical artificial island beach resort with parasols and turquoise water
data.lighting: dazzling tropical daylight softened by beach umbrella canopy
data.mood: pure innocent bashfulness, heart-melting seaside sweetness
data.promptProse: Sitting under a colorful beach umbrella on a tropical shore, Himeragi Yukina wears a modest white frilled bikini. Her dark hair shines in the sunlight as she crosses her arms shyly with an adorable, full-face blush.
data.animaCaption: Yukina sitting under a beach umbrella in a white bikini, blushing shyly.
